author: thedarknight74
quote: Not that great—I prefer *Breath of the Wild*. The graphics are okay, but the story is lackluster and lacks emotion. Plus, I’m really not a fan of how Link and the other characters look; they look like babies... It’s a good thing I didn’t buy this game—or a Nintendo Switch 2—and just played it through other means.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: thedarknight74
quote: The story is forgettable and rubbish; the combat systems are outdated and bland; and the graphics are ugly and archaic—even on PC, and I’m running an RTX 5070! The game is packed with quests, yet it lacks any ultimate goal or final purpose. It was apparently supposed to be a co-op/multiplayer game; I can see why it didn't make the Game Awards' GOTY list—and rightly so. This game is an absolute piece of trash. There are plenty of other games that deserve a spot in the GOTY category far more than this garbage (Capcom, for instance, has some incredible titles). As for those saying *Crimson Desert* should have been included—well, that’s just bizarre and stupid, to put it politely.

author: thedarknight74
quote: GTA VI is incredible; the massive map is truly vast, with a well-managed density and a wide range of activities to engage in. As for the story, Jason and Lucia are interesting and endearing characters who must survive after being betrayed. There is one drawback, however: the vehicle handling. It feels like the developers aimed for a blend of GTA IV and GTA V; at times—such as when driving Jason’s vehicle in Chapter 1—the cars drift a bit too much. Still, for me, this is the game of the year.
